a.name: Litter notice
a.description: A raised white card: Christa's photo on the left, the question, its answer and a stacked email field over a brass submit.
a.differs_from: The only sibling with a photo and a raised card; B is a centred band with no photo, C an open ruled row.

b.name: Steel band
b.description: A compact centred steel-700 band: brass envelope icon, the question in bone, and one joined row of email field and brass submit.
b.differs_from: A centred, compact full-width band with no photo; A is a raised photo card, C a left-set ruled row on the page.

c.name: Ruled row
c.description: Open bone page between a steel rule and a hairline: the question left, the field and submit on one line right, two ticks under it.
c.differs_from: A left-set two-column row framed only by rules, airy; A is a raised photo card, B a centred steel band.
